profile.name: 光学脉冲选择器
profile.description: 用于按事件码控制光束脉冲通断的脉冲选择器。设备可在打开、关闭及多种工作模式之间切换，以选择性放行特定脉冲并阻挡其余脉冲，常用于光学束线或激光实验中的脉冲选通与时序控制。
profile.description_en: A pulse picker used to gate beam pulses based on event codes. The device can switch between open, closed, and several operating modes to pass selected pulses while blocking others, commonly for pulse gating and timing control in optical beamlines or laser experiments.

registry.name: Optical Pulse Picker
registry.description: Optical Pulse Picker驱动，支持burst/close/flipflop/follower/open等6个操作。
